column1: # One pre-app-start transaction; order preserves the tested effective layering
# scheme: f14-runtime.sh used `chcon -R vendor_file` on vendor64/provider_hw,
# hal_camera_default_exec on the two provider binaries; access-runtime.sh used
# vendor_file dirs plus same_process_hal_file files for the RFSA/OpenCL trees.
# App/permission/ODM-config trees carry no explicit relabel ('-'), identical to
# the tested rc7 post-fs-data mounts that ran directly after the manager's
# restorecon pass. The provider_hw row additionally gets the two HAL binaries
# The opencl_runtime row is only valid for an attested overlay GPU layout
# replace rows are overlays with an empty bottom layer. A bind of a module
# directory is an f2fs mount in the userdata peer group, and the camera app
# namespace drops those two binds while keeping overlay mounts. The empty
# bottom layer keeps the full-replace view the bind had: ROM-only names stay
# hidden. This kernel rejects a one-directory lowerdir.
